Do not re-add server packages here. Declaring them at both levels installs a
second, different copy (root had express 5 / mongoose 9 / bcryptjs 3 while
the backend runs express 4 / mongoose 8 / bcryptjs 2), and a root script that
imports 'mongoose' then gets a different instance from the one the backend
models are registered on — connect() succeeds while every query buffers and
times out. scripts/makeAdmin.mjs hit exactly that.
